wandascribe-desc: Waxay bixisaa caawimo qoraal oo loogu talagalay tafatirka wikitext-ka iyadoo adeegsanaysa awoodaha AI ee Wanda, si la mid ah Grammarly
wandascribe-make-casual: Ka dhig mid aan rasmi ahayn
wandascribe-error: Khalad ayaa dhacay. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
wandascribe-no-text-selected: Fadlan dooro qoraal si aad u hesho caawimo.
wandascribe-select-text-hint: Dooro qoraal ku jira tifaftiraha si aad u hesho caawimo qoraal.
wandascribe-wanda-not-available: Kordhinta Wanda lama heli karo ama si sax ah looma habayn.
wandascribe-all-corrections-applied: Dhammaan sixitaannada waa la dhaqan geliyay!
